verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated `RunAnywhere.vlm` API that takes an image together with a text prompt, and the Kotlin SDK documentation says it runs vision models on-device with images kept on the phone. This directly covers running vision-language models that understand images alongside text. Missing for 10: documentation of which VLM models are supported and of output/streaming behavior, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of VLM inference.
